_comment: Copy this file to live-config.json and edit values to control the app centrally.
_comment2: All fields are optional. Remove any field to use the built-in default.

theme._comment: Override CSS accent colours. Any valid CSS color string.

introHub._comment: Remote background image for the Home Hub screen.
introHub.headline: QuickTap Race Week — All challenges this week are QuickTap!

music._comment: Remote music track URLs (must be http:// or https://).

mainTv._comment: Headline shown in the main game TV viewport when no live event is active.
mainTv.headline: QuickTap Race Week 🏃 Every challenge this week is QuickTap Race!

challenge._comment: weeklyMode overrides the player's comp-selection setting for the week.
challenge._comment2: Accepted values: random-games, single-game, user-selection, arcade-only, trivia-only, endurance-only, logic-only, retired, misc, unique
challenge._comment3: weeklyGameKeys is used when weeklyMode is user-selection

social._comment: Pure-data Social and Drama overrides. Algorithms and executable rules remain bundled in the app.

content._comment: These examples can be edited without rebuilding the app. Unknown IDs are harmless.

week_start_ally_check_in: Fresh week. I wanted to make sure you and I are still solid.

compliment.title: Build Rapport
compliment.description: Offer sincere praise and strengthen the connection.

players._comment: Override an AI houseguest's avatar and profile text.
players.name: Finn
players.bio: Returning champion — now playing for redemption.

challengePrompts: Before you come back here, have one honest conversation with the person you trust least.
Before your next visit, verify one promise instead of collecting three more.
For the next hour, keep your plan to yourself and listen to who talks too much.

greeting: Welcome back. I was already watching.
The Big Eye is listening. What brought you in?
farewell: Go then. I will keep score.
I will be here when you return.
Go get some rest. The board will still be moving.
compliment: Careful. Praise can sound like strategy.
You notice quality. I notice motives.
insult: Sharp. And yet not sharp enough.
If that was meant to wound, aim better next time.
Charming. I see why trust is difficult for you.
gratitude: You are welcome. Do not make me sentimental.
Noted. Gratitude is rare currency in this house.
You are welcome. Now spend that clearer head wisely.
love_confession: Careful. Attachment is a weakness here.
We should probably keep this between us.
I will pretend the cameras did not hear that.

returned: I watched you leave. Apparently the House was not finished with you.
newly_nominated: Back already. And this time your name is on the block.
survived_nomination: Still here. That was not guaranteed.
closest_relationship_changed: Your closest connection has changed since the last time you sat in that chair.
late_game: Fewer faces. Heavier choices. Sit down.

directives: Prefer specific callbacks over generic atmosphere.
A very short answer is allowed when it is dramatically sharper.

director._comment: Season orchestration policy. Frequency/window changes are snapshotted when a new season starts; kill switches are live.
